FlashChallenge.title: FlashChallenge
FlashChallenge.description: Shared 24-hour flash dhikr challenge tracking the global highest count and participant count.

title.description: Arabic display title for the 24-hour challenge.

dhikrKey.description: Dhikr counter key linked to the daily log.

targetGoal.description: Default milestone target for the challenge.

topCount.description: Highest count reached by any participant in this 24-hour challenge.

topUserId.description: UID of the user who currently holds topCount.

topUserName.description: Public display name (no PII/email) of the current challenge leader.

participantsCount.description: Total number of users who joined this 24-hour challenge.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the challenge record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last record update.

FlashChallengeEntry.title: FlashChallengeEntry
FlashChallengeEntry.description: Individual user's progress entry inside a 24-hour flash challenge.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the participant.

count.description: Participant's current dhikr count in this challenge.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user joined the challenge.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the user's latest progress update.

/flashChallenges/{challengeId}.description: Shared 24-hour flash challenge documents storing topCount, topUserName, and participantsCount.

/flashChallenges/{challengeId}/entries/{.description: Per-user challenge entry subcollection storing the authenticated participant's count.
